title: Design, synthesis, in silico, anticancer evaluations of N-acylhydrazone derivatives as STAT3 inhibitors.
authors: Panwar, Vivek; Rohila, Yajat; Singh, Aishwarya; Meenakshi; Singh, Bhavana; Gupta, Manoj K; Garg, Manoj; Kumar, Deepak
one_liner_zh: 该文研究N-酰腙衍生物作为STAT3抑制剂的设计合成与抗癌评价，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: AIM: N-acylhydrazone derivatives were synthesized, evaluated in-vitro and further subjected to cell cycle analysis, cell apoptosis, western bloting, and in-silico analysis targeting STAT3. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A series of N-acylhydrazones (5a-5l) were synthesized and evaluated against MIA PaCa-2 cancer cells. 5 h and 5 l were further evaluated against PANC-1, MCF-7 and hTERT-HPNE cells. Additionally, cell cycle analysis, apoptosis, western blotting, docking, in-silico ADMET, molecular dynamics and MM-GBSA were done on 5l. RESULTS AND CONCLUSION: 5 l and 5 h suppressed the growth of MIA PaCa-2 cancer cells and were very less cytotoxic to hTERT-HPNE cells. Additionally, the anticancer efficacy was confirmed against PANC-1 and MCF-7 for 5l and 5h. Further, 5l treatment induced G1/S arrest marked decrease in G2/M and displayed a significant increase in the apoptosis of MIA PaCa-2 cells. 5 l treatment significantly inhibited the phosphorylated level STAT3 and JAK1. In-silico studies confirm the binding affinity and stability and further synthetic modifications and biological investigations can be done to explore the medicinal potential of the derivatives in future.
abstract_zh: 目的：合成N-酰腙衍生物，进行体外评估，并进一步开展细胞周期分析、细胞凋亡、蛋白质印迹及靶向STAT3的计算机模拟分析。材料与方法：合成了一系列N-酰腙类化合物（5a-5l），并针对MIA PaCa-2癌细胞进行评估。5h和5l进一步在PANC-1、MCF-7和hTERT-HPNE细胞中测试。此外，对5l进行了细胞周期分析、凋亡检测、蛋白质印迹、分子对接、计算机模拟ADMET、分子动力学及MM-GBSA分析。结果与结论：5l和5h抑制了MIA PaCa-2癌细胞的生长，并对hTERT-HPNE细胞毒性较低。同时，5l和5h的抗癌效果在PANC-1和MCF-7细胞中得到确认。进一步，5l处理诱导G1/S期阻滞，G2/M期显著减少，并显著增加MIA PaCa-2细胞的凋亡。5l处理显著抑制了STAT3和JAK1的磷酸化水平。计算机模拟研究证实了结合亲和力和稳定性，未来可进行进一步的合成修饰和生物学研究，以探索这些衍生物的药用潜力。
